Step 3 of 3 — Accessibility setup

① Tap the button below
② Find SPENguard in the list
③ If it says Blocked, tap it anyway
④ A dialog appears — tap Allow

⑤ Go to Settings → Apps → SPENguard
⑥ Tap the 3 dots at the top
⑦ Allow restricted settings

⑧ Return to Accessibility → SPENguard → turn on
⑨ Come back to the app

Detects when Samsung\'s Air Command menu opens, which happens when the S Pen is removed from the device, and triggers the alarm. The service only reads window events from the Air Command app and does not collect or transmit any personal information.
